column5: prism-app implements the Tauri updater protocol so existing installs keep updating: download the installer URL from latest.json (`platforms["windows-x86_64"].url`), verify the minisign signature (`signature` field) with the public key in tauri.conf.json `plugins.updater.pubkey` (crate `minisign-verify`), flush persistence before and after the download, write the installer to a temp file, start it with `ShellExecuteW("open", installer, "/P /UPDATE /R /ARGS <current args>", SW_SHOW)` (passive mode with restart, as tauri-plugin-updater 2.12.0 does), then `std::process::exit(0)`. Progress uses update_progress::percent (judge update.percent.*).

column3: when the item can be pinned and has a shell path: reset state to unknown, ask is_pinned_to_taskbar, set the label when the answer arrives for the same item; error -> unknown
column5: `pin_state: Option<bool>` (None = unknown) reset on item change; `pin_task: Option<Task<()>>` replaced on item change so a late answer for the previous item is dropped. The menu label reads "Unpin from taskbar" only for Some(true).

Menu key context: ArrowDown -> next item, wrapping (first item when none is focused); ArrowUp -> previous, wrapping (last item when none is focused); Home -> first; End -> last; Escape or Tab -> close(restore_focus = true) with animation. Each handled key prevents default. Focus moves between the items' FocusHandles.
